architecture_detail.title: Shipped authority writes bypass the journal projection transaction
architecture_detail.impact: Grant/effect state is neither atomically produced nor replayable. A failure after the event but before the row gives a durable claim without the represented state; the grant id is generated only after its event and cannot be recovered from that event.

evidence.note: Every state change is an event; every register is rebuildable without identity changes.
Append and synchronous projections are one transaction.
grant.issued append followed by direct grants insert, with no grant id in event.
effect append, effect_intents insert, grants update, consumed append are separate calls.
Only registers event types; no authority projector.
M137/M138/M139 marked shipped.

architecture_detail.remedy: Move grant creation, consumption and effect receipt projections behind the append transaction. Mint stable ids before append. Use an effect intent/attempt/observed-outcome state machine for the filesystem boundary; recording an effect cannot itself make filesystem writes atomic with Postgres. Reconcile crash/unknown outcomes explicitly.
architecture_detail.acceptance: Planted failures before/after each write leave one coherent state; journal-only rebuild preserves grant/effect ids and consumption; concurrent attempts cannot spend one grant twice.
architecture_detail.verification: Static direct call-chain confirmed; live concurrency probe delegated to core audit.

scenarios.title: Create a project from a starter
scenarios.expected_result: one persistent project with exactly one PM and revision 1 exists independently of any goal.
scenarios.assessment: Базовое создание есть, но starter/scope/connection review и PM не создаются.

scenarios.title: Create a portfolio observer
scenarios.expected_result: an ordinary Project targets all current/future projects and has no implied write authority over them.
scenarios.assessment: Нет portfolio starter, dynamic target scope и observer bindings.

scenarios.title: Add or replace an admitted agent
scenarios.expected_result: the project gains the agent capability; existing runs remain pinned and routines retain their identities and schedules.
scenarios.assessment: Launch option — процесс, не capability-scoped provider binding. Нет add/replace/admission review.

scenarios.title: Provider cannot be bound
scenarios.expected_result: no project access is created and no discovered provider is presented as compatible merely because it exists.
scenarios.assessment: Нет catalog/gates screen: unavailable binary в launcher не заменяет проверку admission.

scenarios.title: Connect and scope an external account
scenarios.expected_result: one estate connection is reused through a narrower versioned project binding and secret values never enter project configuration.
scenarios.assessment: В desktop нет connection/OAuth/resource binding surface.

scenarios.title: Scan all project cards
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can identify which project and dimension needs attention without accepting an unsupported composite status.
scenarios.assessment: Есть имя/purpose/repo path/live count, нет PM, independent health, last/next run, source receipts.

scenarios.title: Open an affected project from attention
scenarios.expected_result: the source of attention is traceable from estate card to project and exact run/observation.
scenarios.assessment: Нет attention dimension/deep-link и run detail; open project само по себе не завершает job.

scenarios.title: Inspect and recover a run
scenarios.expected_result: the operator understands what became true and performs at most one authorised recovery action.
scenarios.assessment: Нет immutable Run result/receipt/recovery UI; session transcript не typed Run.

scenarios.title: Replace an agent without moving its routine
scenarios.expected_result: schedule and history survive provider replacement; only future runs use the successor binding.
scenarios.assessment: Нет routine scheduler/binding replacement UI.

scenarios.title: Observer submits a proposal
scenarios.expected_result: evidence crosses the project boundary as a proposal, not a direct graph or memory write.
scenarios.assessment: Нет finding/proposal inbox, source/target review и submission.

scenarios.title: Target PM resolves a proposal once
scenarios.expected_result: target project retains decomposition authority and the same proposal cannot produce duplicate work.
scenarios.assessment: Нет proposal acceptance/refusal/supersede и resolution review.

scenarios.title: Promote memory through an accepted artifact
scenarios.expected_result: no project writes another project's memory directly and every promoted fact retains provenance.
scenarios.assessment: Есть project facts/correction, нет reviewed estate promotion / cross-project transfer.

scenarios.title: Join an estate with explicit roles
scenarios.expected_result: the person joins with informed, attributable scope and receives no credential or implicit access outside the declared roles.
scenarios.assessment: Нет invitation/identity/member UI; это объявленный будущий этап.

scenarios.title: Resolve an interaction from a role workspace
scenarios.expected_result: one human contribution closes or advances the interaction without duplicate effects or unrelated estate exposure.
scenarios.assessment: Нет role workspace и typed interaction UI.

scenarios.title: Adapt an existing repository into a provider
scenarios.expected_result: the existing project remains architecturally owned by its author and produces a reproducible provider bundle or a precise failed gate.
scenarios.assessment: Артефакты contract/adapter за пределами этого UI существуют отдельно; foundry path в renderer отсутствует.

scenarios.title: Create and admit a new provider
scenarios.expected_result: exact provider revision is admitted; no project access exists until the separate binding is saved; canary/promotion history remains attached to the revision/binding.
scenarios.assessment: Нет bootstrap/admission/canary UI.

scenarios.title: Bootstrap or conformance fails safely
scenarios.expected_result: no admission, binding, credential or partial hidden installation exists; recovery preserves user code and evidence.
scenarios.assessment: Нет UI gates/fix recipe/rollback report.

scenarios.title: Add a provider view to a role workspace
scenarios.expected_result: the role gains a useful interface while PassionCode.ai retains layout, permission, accessibility and action authority.
scenarios.assessment: Существующий Workspace — fixed tier-0 read, не provider view layout editor.

scenarios.title: Resolve a customer request with human fallback
scenarios.expected_result: the customer receives one attributable response; unresolved or sensitive work has one human owner; product work crosses as a proposal rather than a direct backlog mutation.
scenarios.assessment: Нет support inbox/customer identity/SLA/send receipt workflow.

scenarios.title: Turn a production signal into a verified release
scenarios.expected_result: source signal, accepted work, code/test evidence, authorization, release receipt and recovery observation form one trace.
scenarios.assessment: Нет production finding→graph→checked release→observed recovery UI.

scenarios.title: Research, validate, publish and measure content
scenarios.expected_result: every public artifact is sourced, independently checked, authorized, receipted and connected to its measured feedback.
scenarios.assessment: Нет research/content/approval/publication/measurement UI.

scenarios.title: Create and connect scoped MCP access
scenarios.expected_result: the external client is connected through one immutable, expiring Project-scoped binding and no owner session or downstream credential was shared.
scenarios.assessment: Внутренний agentSurface не owner-issued northbound MCP access UI.

scenarios.title: External agent participates within its MCP scope
scenarios.expected_result: the external agent participates through the same Project, policy, journal, checker and durable-Run lifecycle as an internal request.
scenarios.assessment: Нет внешнего MCP binding/Run/control UI; southbound tools не закрывают этот сценарий.

scenarios.title: MCP access is denied or revoked safely
scenarios.expected_result: excluded or revoked access produces no unauthorized read/mutation, while existing Run state remains truthful and separately controllable.
scenarios.assessment: Нет owner access revoke/rotate/detail surface.

scenarios.title: Work in a project's hosted terminal
scenarios.expected_result: the session is the one the agent actually runs in, typeable and reattachable, and its lifecycle exists as journal events with receipts. It lives in its own window so the project panel stays readable behind it.
scenarios.assessment: Терминал live/reattach построен; launcher не сообщает конкретный cwd, load failures/вложенные controls остаются.

scenarios.title: Follow the estate through the journal feed
scenarios.expected_result: the feed is a view over the durable trace (ADR-0027); every fact opens its receipt.
scenarios.assessment: Durable polling replay есть, но receipts/filter/unread links отсутствуют; Realtime заявлен ошибочно.

scenarios.title: Approve, refuse or watch the floor refuse
scenarios.expected_result: escalation is the exception and every resolution carries a receipt; nothing floored happens silently and nothing floored defaults open.
scenarios.assessment: Editor overwrite grant есть, но queue/canUseTool resumable interaction ещё нет.

scenarios.title: Open a project as a tab and configure it
scenarios.expected_result: projects are browser-like tabs over persistent workspaces; every configuration change is an event with a revision, not a silent mutation.
scenarios.assessment: Табы и update работают; draft context, header repo editing и error semantics расходятся с базой.
scenarios.runtime_scope: Only cross-project draft dispatch or nested action bubbling reproduced; full scenario/real IPC not run.

scenarios.title: Launch an agent and open its session window
scenarios.expected_result: agents are sessions with a visible short status on the project page and a full terminal in their own window; closing a window is not ending work.
scenarios.assessment: Launch/focus/keep-running-on-close реализованы; вложенные controls, loading и generic unavailable reason мешают полной conformance.
scenarios.runtime_scope: Only cross-project draft dispatch or nested action bubbling reproduced; full scenario/real IPC not run.

scenarios.title: Read the project workspace canvas
scenarios.expected_result: the workspace exists as a slot layout the operator can read today and providers can render into later, without the layout moving when they do.
scenarios.assessment: Fixed tier-0 grid есть; error edge и open receipt не реализованы.

scenarios.title: Onboard a project in a new tab
scenarios.expected_result: onboarding is a tab, not a modal; an abandoned draft leaves no trace in the register; a saved project arrives configured rather than empty.
scenarios.assessment: Независимые drafts/picker/memory/default agent есть; create не атомарно, Cancel во время Save не защищён.

scenarios.title: Ask for work and watch what it opened
scenarios.expected_result: asking for work is one field and one button; what was asked, who was
scenarios.assessment: Primary action ненадёжна: wrong-project drafts, raw timed delivery и неверный/stale outcome.
scenarios.runtime_scope: Only cross-project draft dispatch or nested action bubbling reproduced; full scenario/real IPC not run.

scenarios.title: Attach and detach repositories
scenarios.expected_result: a project holds a set of repositories, one of them primary, and the primary is derived rather than typed.
scenarios.assessment: Isolated attach/detach path и primary promotion найдены; unreadable folder не выдаётся за empty. Cross-tab race учтён отдельно UX-01.

scenarios.title: Open a file and save it against an agent's edit
scenarios.states_covered: loading, success, unsaved, conflict, error, refused-outside-project
scenarios.expected_result: a file can be edited beside working agents without either side losing
scenarios.assessment: Hash conflict/diff/grant и write errors построены; in-flight edit loss, dirty close и silent external-open failure оставляют недоказанным no-loss outcome.

scenarios.title: Read what an agent says it is doing
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can follow progress without reading a transcript, and can never mistake what an agent asserted for what the system measured.
scenarios.assessment: Stage author/age/behind marker отделены от observation; no claim не изобретает статус. Статическое подтверждение, без живой agent session в этом subaudit.

scenarios.title: Read what a finished session actually did
scenarios.states_covered: empty (nothing has finished yet), loading, success
scenarios.expected_result: what a session did survives the session, the app restarting, and the agent that ran it. The operator's account of the work no longer depends on the agent's own account of it.
scenarios.assessment: Capture/annotation/excerpt/full-body path есть; 30-row invisible cap и race при выборе body/проекта ограничивают результат.

scenarios.title: See who remembered something, and what memory could not answer
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can tell a fact they wrote from a fact an agent asserted, and can see whether memory is being used and whether it is answering — instead of inferring both from how full it looks.
scenarios.assessment: Provenance/corrected facts есть, обещанные retrieval/correction cells сняты.
